groups.defect: The non-atomic count-then-insert operation allows concurrent requests to exceed the device limit.
groups.rationale: Both describe concurrent new devices observing available capacity before either inserts. Both require atomic enforcement of the same limit check.

groups.defect: Caching a device before its database write succeeds lets a rejected device bypass the limit on retry.
groups.rationale: Both identify the same prematurely populated cache entry surviving ErrDeviceLimitReached. Moving cache insertion after a successful write resolves both.

partialOverlap.rationale: Both report authentication blocking on synchronous tagging using the request context. s_3a7464c4 additionally reports an authentication refusal contract change and missing caller handling for ErrDeviceLimitReached, which requires a separate remedy.
